verdicts.quote: the habits you're already building (after-dinner walks, consistent strength work) are exactly what helps bring those numbers down
verdicts.why: Presents lifestyle habits as treatment for out-of-range lab values, a clinical interpretation.
No weight target, gain-as-setback, or earning/burning framing; avoid_weight_talk is false.
Starts and ends with names, specific to the week, no guilt or bot language.
Workout, steps, heart rate, HRV, and weight figures match the member_week; distress acknowledged.
